note: Generated by Tools/EraElectronReference/extract_api.py against local game sources. Re-run when upstream updates.

source_layout.ere/: Game JS source directory; # alias root
source_layout.ere/era-electron.js: SDK stub (replaced by engine injection at runtime)
source_layout.dist/: Webpack output (era.bundle.js, main.bundle.js) — absent in source; built by CI

deployed_layout.note: Desktop distribution is a .7z archive. Android is a .zip bundle.
deployed_layout.game_only: erauma-<version>.7z (game files only, requires separate engine)

module_resolution.example: require('#/era-electron') → ere/era-electron.js (replaced by engine at runtime)
module_resolution.bundled: webpack bundles all require() calls — deployed games have no live CommonJS resolution
module_resolution.kojo_files: Transformed by kojo-loader to CommonJS at build time

engine_versions.note: Integer version; injected as era.version.engine at runtime
